_comment: Copy to ~/.codex-langgraph-agent/config.json (global) or <repo>/.agent/config.json (per repo), or point at it with --config. Delete the _comment keys; they are only here because JSON has no comments. 'codex', 'claude_code', 'antigravity' and 'fake' are implemented; 'api' is a stub that fails at startup with instructions for filling it in.

roles._comment: Anything not listed here inherits 'default'. Merging is per field, so a role can override just the model.
